|rulings=* During initiation of this Interrupt, a player chooses a weapon to fire, not a target to fire at. Opponent's response (such as [[Sense (Dark){{!}}Sense]]) is played before the target to fire at is chosen. A response to the weapon targeting (e.g. [[Blaster Deflection]]) is played slightly later, after that target is chosen.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Sniper</ref>
* [[I Have A Bad Feeling About This]] may retarget to a different weapon that can fire, but cannot choose a new target to fire at (because no target to fire at has been selected yet).
